messages:
Maya: Quick stand-up — want to lock owners/timelines for the postmortem action items from yesterday's multi-region spike. Short replies only.

Aj: I'll own cloud provider mitigations (region failover test + provider SLA contact). ETA EOD Fri for the test plan.

Stella: I'll take model registry auth (rotate short-lived tokens, add health check + dashboard). ETA Wed.

Samir: I'll own diagnostics/metrics: add an alert for cache miss storm and KV eviction patterns. ETA Tue.

Lucy: I'll update the runbook and the incident checklist, and schedule a DR drill. ETA next Tue.

ops-bot: Incident IM-2026-1123 created: postmortem draft started — https://redwood.internal/postmortems/IM-2026-1123 :white_check_mark:

Maya: Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) add owners to the shared sheet (https://docs.google.com/.../postmortem-actions) 2) open PRs in the postmortem-actions repo and tag #pm-followup

Aj: noted. One blocker: provider support flagged overlap with their maintenance windows that could skew failover tests. I'll escalate to our rep and update by Thursday.

Stella: For registry auth — current TTL is 1h. Can we temporarily increase to 6h while we add refresh+rotation logic? Concern about token blast if compromised.

Maya: short-term 6h is fine as a mitigation but we need a tracked card for refresh+rotation (Stella + Omar-Security). Security, confirm?

Omar-Security: Security OK with 6h temp window provided we rotate keys and limit scope. I'll own immediate key rotation + audit. ETA Thu noon.

Samir: Adding alert rule draft — will open PR today. Snippet:```prometheus_alerts.yml
- alert: ModelRegistryAuthErrors
  expr: increase(registry_auth_failures[5m]) > 5
  for: 5m
```

Lucy: I'll schedule a dry-run failover for next Wed 10:00 PT and send the invite. Also proposing a monthly recurring "external deps" check-in (lightweight smoke tests + calendar reminder).

Maya: recurring checks sound good. One more ask: who can own the recurring-pattern analysis across incidents (are registry TTLs + provider flakiness correlated)?

Stella: I'll add a dashboard query to correlate auth failures with region latency/spike events and ping Eng-Ops. ETA Fri.

Maya: Perfect. I'll consolidate statuses and open PR list Fri EOD. If anyone needs to reassign ownership before then, ping me now.
